criteria: Six-minute final window with at least 10 completed cycles. Shape test: the six final private minute medians must not rise monotonically. Size test: final-window net <=max(64KiB, 1% of the plateau median) and band <=max(1MiB, 1.5% of the plateau median); the tolerance is scaled to the plateau because allocator churn at a ~350MB steady state oscillates by several megabytes, and a fixed byte bound would report noise as growth. Whole-run test: the step between the first and last post-warm-up quarter median must stay within max(4MiB, 1.5% of the plateau), and a monotone four-quarter climb additionally has to stay within the 1% net allowance — cache warm-up past the 120s mark settles slowly, which the 2.0.2 baseline also measured as +1.6MB, so only growth beyond those bounds counts as a leak. Whole-run resident quarter medians must not independently flag sustained growth. All post-cycle engine node/resource/object counts exactly flat with zero orphans. Finite stability review, not zero-byte growth or leak-freedom proof.
